rationale: Injected purified DHA lengthened strides in parkinsonian rats, while fish oil added to exercise did not clearly change stride in older adults. No grilled trout comparison in Parkinson’s.
The Parkinson dyskinesia trial assigned DHA and assessed dyskinesia. The separate whole trout trial measured cardiovascular markers in healthy volunteers. No baked trout comparison in Parkinson’s.

Fatty-fish advice showed an inconclusive tendency toward higher anxiety. The Parkinson cohort pools sardines with other oily fish, and sardine oil studies measured postpartum mood. No baked sardine anxiety estimate.

A confirmed botulism outbreak linked dysarthria to contaminated preserved sardines. The Parkinson dataset pools oily fish and composite motor scores. No grilled sardine speech intelligibility estimate.
Canned sardine feeding trials did not measure fatigue severity. One child with clinical botulism after canned sardines had acute fatigue. No Parkinson-specific canned sardine fatigue comparison.
Existing protein studies differ from boiled shrimp. A non-Parkinson frailty cohort reported pooled shellfish and treated prior falls as a covariate. No boiled shrimp fall estimate.
The shrimp scampi case reported acute dysarthria and confusion with concurrent bacteremia. No visual hallucination outcome or grilled shrimp comparison in Parkinson’s surfaced.
The Parkinson fish oil trial had no clear difference in Epworth sleepiness scores. Neither it nor the related childhood fish feeding trial tested grilled trout.
Two clinical reports describe dysarthria in possible poisoning or infection settings. Neither isolates boiled shrimp or measures Parkinson speech intelligibility.
A pediatric fish meal trial reported a modest nondominant-hand peg test improvement. Fish species were herring and mackerel. Whole trout trials used other outcomes.

A mixed shrimp gel and a fiber-only diet increased mouse pellet output. Extracted shell chitosan did not clearly improve human bowel outcomes. No boiled shrimp trial in Parkinson constipation surfaced.
Fish-advice mood scores and marine-capsule trials differ by population and instrument. Whole trout and emotion data are unposted. No poached trout depression result in Parkinson’s.
